# IMAP command tags use an owned string while exposing a borrowed character pointer

The adjusted 1360 reland replaces the fixed eleven-byte tag buffer with nsCString, formats the unsigned counter with nsPrintfCString and returns .get() from the getter. Those forms remain accepted. A scoped C++ recommendation is to retain owned string storage at the member boundary and use the borrowed pointer only within its owner’s valid lifetime; this change does not authorize callers to store the pointer across later tag mutation. This is static source and test-code inspection. Full Bugzilla and historical review timeline/inline context remain pending. No Thunderbird runtime, build, lint or live accessibility validation ran.

Scope: mailnews/imap/src.
